name: context-guru
description: Installs a local context-guru proxy, routes this project's Claude Code sessions through it, and reports what it saved. Reversible: /context-guru:uninstall removes the one settings key it adds and stops the proxy.

port.title: Proxy port
port.description: Local port the proxy listens on. The port must be FIXED rather than negotiated: the ANTHROPIC_BASE_URL written into your settings and the session hook that starts the proxy have to agree, and a URL cannot be renegotiated after it is written. Leave it unset and a free port is allocated for this project on install and recorded, one project per port — two projects sharing a proxy made every session start restart it. Set it only to pin a specific port; the scan starts at 8787, deliberately not 4000, which collides with litellm.

preset.title: Preset
preset.description: What happens to the request body. `off` (the default) forwards it untouched. `house` trims obvious waste and is the safe first step; `codesmart` adds a cheap-model relevance pass; `housellm` goes furthest and spends on its own. Separate from Cache strategy below, which pings the cache by default regardless of this setting. Easier to pick from `/context-guru:preset-picker`, which explains each one.

cache_strategy.title: Cache strategy
cache_strategy.description: Which cache mechanism runs, by name. `5-min-ping` (the default) pings your idle session so the cache doesn't go cold — it SPENDS your own credential to do it. `none` turns that off. `1-hour-head` asks the provider for a longer-lived cache instead of pinging, only on prefixes >=50k tokens, and usually buys nothing on today's models. `/context-guru:cache-strategy-picker` explains each one and whether it's paying for itself.

idle_exit.title: Idle exit
idle_exit.description: Exit the proxy after this long with no requests and no keep-alive ping pending, so nothing is left running on your machine. Must be at least 2x the store's entry lifetime (~5h34m at the default), because exiting clears in-memory cache state.

upstream.title: Upstream base URL
upstream.description: Forward to this Anthropic-compatible base URL instead of api.anthropic.com. Set it when something else is already the gateway — a hosted agent pod, a corporate gateway — so the proxy CHAINS behind it rather than replacing it. That gateway keeps holding the credential and, on at least one pod, rewriting model names: bypassing it sends model ids the real API has never heard of and every request fails. Empty means go straight to Anthropic.
